articles.title: Grand Theft Auto 6: An Extended Look Global Release Times Confirmed
articles.summary: Netflix will exclusively debut GTA 6 gameplay footage this Thursday, August 27 via its Grand Theft Auto 6: An Extended Look, which will remain exclusive to the streaming platform for six hours.
body: While the past week has seen persistent GTA 6 leaks hit the headlines, these short snippets of open-world footage feel like they have only scratched the surface of what Rockstar has been building. Here's hoping this week reveals a good sense of both protagonists, Jason and Lucia, and our best look yet at the game's world in high-definition.

The past few months have seen a steady uptick in activity promoting GTA 6 after Rockstar revealed the cover art for GTA 6 back in June. Some fans had expected the game's third trailer to debut shortly after, but Rockstar instead released a big batch of new GTA 6 screenshots, which tease all kinds of new details about the game.

It's now been more than 500 days since the arrival of Trailer 2 back in May 2025 — so long ago that when you go back and watch it, the trailer still has GTA 6's previous release date attached to it. But rather than debut its long-awaited Trailer 3 alongside preorders, Rockstar has now confirmed this meatier look at the game, which is now just days away.

articles.title: [UPDATE] GTA 6 Leaker Releases Nightclub and Beach Gameplay Videos, Defends Crypto Scheme
articles.summary: UPDATE: Hot on the heels of the nightclub gameplay leak, CyberLeek has released a 13th video, this time showing off Jason cycling on a beach packed with NPCs. This new video includes the same watermarked memecoin advertisement and crypto statement detailed in the original story, below.
body: The leaks appear to be ramping up ahead of Netflix's official GTA 6 reveal ( check out the global release times here ).
ORIGINAL STORY: The GTA 6 leaks have continued, this time with a new gameplay video and a message from the leaker defending their crypto scheme.

But this new video also includes a watermarked message that defends the crypto scheme. “Stop the hate,” the message reads. “Channel that energy into protests. Not at those actually fighting for you. CL is taking huge risks in this battle. Leeks are free and donations cover operational costs. Using crypto is the only way. CL can’t win alone. Today is the day to show support and protest.”

CyberLeek has launched paid-for polls with a number of gameplay video choices people can vote on by sending tokens. People have spent hundreds of dollars' worth of the tokens to vote. This crypto scheme is ostensibly about protesting our all-digital future and Rockstar’s decision not to sell GTA 6 on-disc. At least one person showed up at Rockstar North in Scotland, filming themselves eating a leek outside the office.

articles.title: Gamescom Opening Night Live 2026: Start Time, How To Watch, And What To Expect
articles.summary: The second of Geoff Keighley's big three shows, Gamescom Opening Night Live, kicks off in a few hours, and it's looking to be another big livestream full of new game trailers and reveals. Like previous years, ONL will be livestreamed directly from Germany, following a 30-minute preshow.
body: Gamescom Opening Night Live and the preshow will be livestreamed through the official YouTube and Twitch channels. You can also watch it live via the official Gamescom website.

You can start watching the preshow at 10:30 AM PT / 1:30 PM PT on August 25, and the big Gamescom Opening Night Live show will start immediately after at 11 AM PT / 2 PM PT. Gamescom Opening Night Live is scheduled to run for around two hours.

That's a pretty stacked lineup, and with the next couple of months looking to feature a chunky selection of titles looking to avoid being caught in GTA 6's wake when it launches in November, we could be in for an especially packed edition of Gamescom Opening Night Live this year. A new look at Final Fantasy 7 Revelation comes just a few months after it was shown off in detail at Keighley's other show, Summer Games Fest, and we'll likely get our first look at the real-time strategy gameplay for Game of Thrones: War for Westeros.

articles.title: GTA 6 Leak Subpoena: Discord Says It Will 'Evaluate the Validity and Scope Before Responding'
articles.summary: Discord has countered online reports about Take-Two’s hunt for the identity of the GTA 6 leaker, saying it has yet to be formally served a subpoena, and when it does receive it, it will take a long, hard look at it before responding.
body: On Friday, Andrew L. Carter Jr., Judge of the United States District Court for the Southern District of New York, granted Take-Two's request to subpoena Discord to divulge identifying information about users the Rockstar owner believes are tied to the leaks.

Take-Two’s subpoena of Microsoft was also granted. But while Microsoft has issued a statement to say it’s happy to work with Take-Two and Rockstar to help unearth the GTA 6 leaker, Discord issued a different line overnight.

“I can share an update on this,” Discord marketing director Ryan K. Rigney said in a tweet. “Discord has not yet been served with a subpoena from Take-Two. When we do, we'll evaluate the validity and scope before responding.”
Reclaim The Net, a group that advocates for free speech and privacy, criticised the Discord subpoena in a tweet.

articles.title: Zach Cregger's Resident Evil Movie Includes First-Person Sequences — and Yes, Umbrella Is Involved
articles.summary: Zach Cregger's Resident Evil movie will pay homage to the series' first-person gameplay, newly-released footage has revealed. A fresh video featuring Cregger discussing his upcoming horror adaptation also includes several quick shots from a first-person perspective, with the barrel of a shotgun and…
body: The first moment sees a character — presumably Austin abrams' protagonist Bryan — sneaking through a house with a double-barrelled shotgun raised. The next shot we see is from behind the hands of a character — presumably Bryan again — holding a pistol as a zombie woman leaps towards him, and the camera.

In his commentary, Cregger discusses how his movie will pay homage to how the Resident Evil games typically start players off with a simple pistol, before granting access to a shotgun and later a machine gun. We can see this in the footage shown so far, with the zombie woman seemingly the first undead that Bryan encounters (he hits her on the road) before he takes shelter in a nearby house (and finds a shotgun inside).

And if you're sat there confused as to why first-person is now a thing in Resident Evil, well, the series has evolved a long way since the fixed-camera perspectives of the original Resident Evil 1. Several recent entries have featured a first-person viewpoint, which is also optional in this year's Resident Evil Requiem.

articles.title: Spider-Man remains Marvel’s #1 superhero in real-life fight against racists
articles.summary: In an act of vigilante justice, a Spider-Man cosplayer went viral over the weekend for throwing hands with a group of white supremacists in Minneapolis. A video showed the cosplayer confronting a group of far-right “activists” who were holding a sign with a racial slur.
body: The white supremacist demonstration was organized by Jake Lang, a notorious racist and right-wing provocateur. Lang participated in the Jan. 6 riots at the Capitol and served prison time before being pardoned by Donald Trump. As for this weekend's incident, Lang was protesting the sentencing of Shiloh Hendrix, a woman found guilty of yelling racial slurs at a Black autistic child on a playground. Lang’s protest was met with a much larger counter-protest, as Minneapolis citizens flooded the streets to stop the hateful demonstration. Local reporter Mark Wasson posted a video of the brawl on TikTok.

After the clash, police arrested both the Spider-Man cosplayer and Lang. Keyssy Ayala Castro Figuero identified himself as the cosplayer and posted a GoFundMe page to help cover his legal fees and medical bills from the incident — he was allegedly tackled and struck by police. The fundraiser has already made almost $12,000 in donations.
points: In an act of vigilante justice, a Spider-Man cosplayer went viral over the weekend for throwing hands with a group of white supremacists in Minneapolis.
A video showed the cosplayer confronting a group of far-right “activists” who were holding a sign with a racial slur.

articles.title: Synths, impossible physics, and an "erotic experience with a PS5 controller" - the side projects of game devs are a reminder creativity is undimmable
articles.summary: If there's been one theme I'd pick out from the many of these past few years of gaming discontent, it's the sense of all-out assault on creativity. This is the thing that makes games what they are, that makes them successful, that earns people money and gives people a reason to do the job in the…
body: Obviously that's bobbins. But that's the way it's been going, and I think a great deal of the sense of crushing, down-weighing hopelessness has been a direct result of human creativity, specifically, being the default sacrifice of an industry far too willing to wield the ceremonial knife. But if that's a source of hopelessness, then in a roundabout way that also means there's some hope to be found. Because - and sorry, this is going to be cheesy but you're just going to have to take it - human beings' creativity is undimmable.

People doing something just for the want of doing it, making something because they had the urge to make, imagining a thing into existence just because they can, is about as inseparable from humanity as it gets. This is just what humans do - especially if those people have found themselves working in a fundamentally creative industry in the first place. Whether it's for healing or comfort or distraction, or to vent frustration, work through anger, to recharge or clear the mind, people just make stuff.

articles.title: Despite being a Switch 2 exclusive, The Duskbloods closed network test had more applications than Elden Ring Nightreign
articles.summary: The Duskbloods is already looking like it's going to be a very popular game. Developer FromSoftware revealed the game's network test, which finished yesterday, attracted more player applications than those for Elden Ring Nightreign, despite it only being available for one platform: Switch 2.
body: Game producer Yasuhiro Kitao revealed the news during a Famitsu livestream (via GamesRadar ), and said the team was surprised to see that response.

Of course, compared to Nightreign, The Duskbloods' potential player base is far smaller, as the game is a Switch 2 exclusive. Though Nintendo's hybrid console has been breaking sales records, its installed base is significantly smaller than PS5 and Xbox Series X/S combined, the two platforms Nightreign's test ran on. Nightreign also released on PC, PS4 and Xbox One, making for an even larger potential audience.

That was something Kitao brought up during the livestream, saying that the studio wonders if The Duskbloods will have more day-one players based on player interest in the test, despite the Switch 2's smaller installed base.

The Duskbloods' network test hasn't been without problems, though. Its first session ended abruptly following major connectivity issues. Later sessions seemingly ran more smoothly, however. The Duskbloods still does not have a release date, even if, briefly, it looked like it would be released 24th September.
points: The Duskbloods is already looking like it's going to be a very popular game.

articles.title: It's the End of an Era for This Star Wars Character
articles.summary: The beauty of Star Wars Unlimited is that, as long as you have the know-how, every Star Wars card has a place at the table. However, it's a fact that some cards are better than others, and if you're playing competitively in Premier, you'll want the very best to help you claim those wins.
body: One such card that stood out in competitive play was Cad Bane: Still Faster Than You. An aggressive villain leader introduced in Ashes of the Empire, Cad's ability lets him whittle down enemies and units, making him a powerful early-game threat. However, as the game progressed, he was downright frustrating to deal with. Cad has become such a problem that, as game developer Ryan Miles announced on Unlimited's official website, he is suspended from Premier.
"The data behind Cad Bane is extremely clear: the leader is a power outlier through and through, and he warps the entire metagame around him while still putting up dominant win rates," writes Miles.

Cad quickly found his feet in Premier, appearing several times throughout events and tournaments — including the winning deck of the Galactic Championship that took place in Las Vegas last month. The leader card has also featured heavily in other Unlimited Sector Qualifiers following the championship. However, with the suspension, Cad's time in competitive play has come to an end.

To promote Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 2, which comes out Aug. 27, plush pet toys and cat collars inspired by Peace Walker and Guns of the Patriots will be available.

Cat lovers who just so happen to be Metal Gear fans may want to check out these products, as they might become extremely hard to find in the future. The cat products will only be available at CatCon and OKS Gear Shop during the days that the convention takes place. The limited availability makes these products great targets for scalpers. articles.title: Discord is yet to be served Take-Two's GTA 6 leak subpoena, which is set to demand broad access to user data
articles.summary: Discord has said that it has not yet been served a subpoena from Take-Two regarding Grand Theft Auto 6 leaks. On Friday, it was reported that the Rockstar parent company filed multiple subpoenas in a federal district court in order to obtain a wide range of user data from Discord and Microsoft…
body: Some Discord users fear the scope of the subpoena is so broad it potentially affects all users of the Discord servers where the leaks circulated, which number in the hundreds of thousands.
"I can share an update on this: Discord has not yet been served with a subpoena from Take-Two," K. Rigney wrote on X on Monday. "When we do, we'll evaluate the validity and scope before responding."

It's worth noting that filing a subpoena is separate to actually serving a party with one, and that companies are not required to respond to a subpoena until they have been formally served it. The subpoena itself has been filed by Take-Two, and so it would seem Discord is simply yet to receive an actual formal service.

According to the filing, Take-Two is requesting data that includes registration emails, registration and last-login IP addresses, phone numbers, linked connections and associated device identifiers for "all user accounts that are/were members" of multiple Discord community servers, including Ødyssey.gg, "! Odyssey", and DarkViperAU from 1st June.
points: Discord has said that it has not yet been served a subpoena from Take-Two regarding Grand Theft Auto 6 leaks.

articles.title: Ridley Scott's Canceled 2-Part Sci-Fi Streaming Series Is "Westworld Meets Blade Runner"
articles.summary: Ridley Scott has spent nearly five decades returning to the same basic question: What does it mean to be human when the world around us stops making sense? From the industrial nightmare of Alien to the neon-soaked existentialism of Blade Runner, Scott's science fiction has always been interested in…
body: Scott's new post-apocalyptic thriller, The Dog Stars, looks to leverage those same principles in the director’s first sci-fi film since 2017’s Alien: Covenant. Based on a book by Peter Heller, the script follows a group of survivors trying to carve out some kind of life after the collapse of human civilization, with isolation gradually giving way to the possibility of human connection. It's another Scott story about humans trying to figure out what remains after the systems they depended on have long vanished.
If that sounds like your kind of Ridley Scott science fiction, there's a very good chance you somehow missed Raised by Wolves.

articles.title: Two architectures on one chip: Arm and IBM team up in a legendary crossover, but alas it's for 'enterprise infrastructure'
articles.summary: Though us PC gamers are unlikely to get the benefit of it, sometimes some new bit of PC hardware comes out of the enterprise market that just makes you go 'huh, that's neat'. Today, it's a new chip from IBM made in collaboration with Arm that runs architectures from both companies on a single chip.
body: Prior to this, running multiple sets of instructions would require emulating the right instructions, ie, turning instructions from one architecture to another that can actually be processed by the cores. Though we won't know how well it runs in use until the chip actually launches, it's still an interesting bit of tech that could be more versatile long-term.

Combining two different architectures in one chip is very uncommon, though not unprecedented. The Register spoke to tech analyst George Cozma, and he explained: "Back in the deep, dark annals of the mid-1990s, IBM developed the PowerPC 615, a chip that could run both PowerPC and x86 code, with the active ISA selected at boot… The chip was reportedly intended for Apple during the clone era, but it was never sold publicly."

Arm says it is built for "the next era of enterprise infrastructure", and that includes, as one might expect, cloud and AI infrastructure. Its current chips are reportedly used by over 22 million developers worldwide, including businesses like Nvidia, Microsoft, and Google.

articles.title: The upcoming Resident Evil movie will have first-person POVs as it demonstrates how authenticity is a moving target for a series that spans 30 years
articles.summary: If there's one thing I know about the upcoming Resident Evil film it's that the director Zach Cregger is doing the utmost to stay true to the series' roots. "I happen to worship these Resident Evil games and pull a lot of inspiration from the experience of playing them," Cregger reminds fans in a…
body: I've already explained why this means he knows ball. But authenticity is a moving target for a series which just turned 30 years old, and has made some pretty monumental changes over the last three decades. Exactly what Cregger chooses to remain true to isn't as clear cut as some may think.

One example of this can be found in the latest teaser for the film, which shows a first-person camera angle of Bryan creeping through corridors and shooting down some speedy infected. An OG Resident Evil fan could faint at the sight of this, as traditionally, a third-person or fixed perspective were what you would see in a Resident Evil game. But this isn't the late 90s anymore, in fact, Resident Evil hasn't had an new exclusively third person perspective for almost a decade now.

Apart from that little hiccup at the start of 2000, 2017 was the first time Resident Evil scrapped the third person perspective with Resident Evil 7: Biohazard, with Capcom opting for a first-person perspective instead.

articles.title: 31 years later, beautiful SNES RPG Terranigma is finally coming to PC, and I must lay the ghost of my console warrior childhood to rest
articles.summary: Clear River Games Development and Limited Run are working on a PC re-release of Terranigma, Quintet's Super Nintendo Entertainment System action-RPG from 1995. I never played Terranigma, for I was raised according to the Holy Maxim that Sega do what Nintendon't.
body: RPS guides writer Jeremy did play Terranigma, however, and says it's one of his favourite games ever. For the sake of collegiality, I guess I'll suppress my emaciated console war impulses and take a look. Gosh, this is a pretty trailer.

Terranigma takes place on a hollow planet with a civilisation divided between the outer Lightside and the internal Darkside. You are Ark, a mischievous Darkside kid who one day opens a forbidden door, as is the pastime of RPG protagonists.

It's certainly a looker, with character designs from manga artist Kamui Fujiwara, a touch of mode 7 aviation, and some lush Polly Pocket battle scenery and villages. The battle system is real-time, with Ark darting around stabbing away with his spear.

"The games developed by Quintet in the ’90s were marked by a distinct melancholy and recurring themes of creation and destruction," utters the GOG page (it's also coming to Steam ). "Terranigma is their magnum opus: a technical and storytelling powerhouse and a timeless classic. If you missed it in 1995, this is your chance to experience something truly special."

videos.summary: A lost legend is getting ready to rise from the ashes! Watch the Terranigma trailer for a peek at the world and story of this action RPG, as this classic from 1995 returns and will be available to play on modern consoles.
body: The Earth is a hollow sphere with two sides: an external Lightside and an internal Darkside. In the Darkside village of Crysta, the mischievous Ark lives unaware of the world beyond. But one day, he opens a forbidden door and sets in motion events that will change the world.
points: A lost legend is getting ready to rise from the ashes!
Watch the Terranigma trailer for a peek at the world and story of this action RPG, as this classic from 1995 returns and will be available to play on modern consoles.
Terranigma will be available on Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox Series X/S, and PC (Steam and GOG) in 2027.

videos.summary: Thanks to MSI for sponsoring this video. Purchase an eligible QD-OLED display and share your feedback for the chance to get a game code for Onimusha: Way of the Sword
body: We're not going to be commenting on leaks from a stolen GTA 6 build that's years old and promoting a memecoin but we WILL be talking about Sony's comments on not knowing PS6's pricing and release date and assessing the Black Myth Zhong Kui gameplay reveal. Rich is intrigued by Alan Wake's big PC upgrade for AMD users, while John muses over the reported end of live service elements in Horizon Hunters Gathering. Finally, five years ago, Alex made a range of predictions about Switch 2 and DLSS... so how accurate did they turn out to be?
